note: Structures recovered from decompiled E3D 3.1 core.dll functions. Field offsets marked with evidence source. Magic constants differ from 2.10 docs. Fields marked 'uncertain' need further decompile verification.

fixture_corrections.byte_order: BIG-ENDIAN (Fortran legacy convention, NOT little-endian). Confirmed by fixture ams1112_0001.
fixture_corrections.page_size_unit: The descriptor field at offset 0x34 stores page size in 4-byte WORDS, not bytes. Multiply by 4 to get byte size. Example: 512 words = 2048 bytes. Confirmed by fixture: 103786496 / 2048 = 50677 pages, matching latest_ses_pgno=50676.

refno_encoding.description: How a RefNo (element reference number) is encoded as two 32-bit words
refno_encoding.evidence: sub_5AEB6B0 bit extraction at function entry

fields.name: word0
fields.description: First 32 bits. Contains dbno in low bits: dbno = word0 & 0x1FFF | (word0 >> 13) & 0x3E000

fields.name: word1
fields.description: Second 32 bits. Must be >= 0 (sign bit check). Used as hash key: hash_index = word1 % hash_size
fields.evidence: if (a1[1] < 0) goto error; hash: a1[1] % dword_6A540C8

page_address_encoding.description: How a page address + slot is encoded in a single 32-bit value (returned by index search)

fields.name: slot_offset
fields.description: Low 13 bits of second word: slot offset within page (& 0x1FFF)

fields.name: record_slot_index
fields.description: Bits 13-24 of second word: record slot index within page ((v38 >> 13) & 0xFFF)
